name: Ice Rush
hook: 3-on-3 hockey: slap shots, body checks, goal horns.
how: Skate with real momentum, scoop up the puck and carry it on your stick. Hold to charge a slap shot, pass to a teammate, or body-check whoever has the puck. Each team has a goalie bot; most goals after three periods wins.
controls: WASD or arrows to skate, hold Space to shoot, X to pass, C to check, or a thumb stick with Shoot, Pass and Check buttons
uses: One player's browser moves the puck, runs the goalies and keeps the score, so everyone sees the same play; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill every empty skater spot and both nets, so it's always 3 on 3 plus goalies.
Every skater and the puck move for everyone at once.
ideas: Add a power play: a checked player sits out for 5 seconds
Make the rink bigger with 4 on 4
Add a fire puck power-up that shoots twice as fast
